_meta.note: STRATEGY NARRATIVE — this file is Kusumgar's own strategic view and illustrative estimates. It is NOT market data. Every real market number in the deck comes from market_intel.json (UN Comtrade) and research_targets.json (verified companies). Edit freely.

exec_summary.headline: 600D PU-coated polyester is a large, China-concentrated global market — a clear China+1 opening for a proven Indian technical-textile maker.
points: The world coated-fabric trade is real and sizeable (see market slide) and heavily supplied by China.
Buyers across bags, medical, marine and covers want a credible non-China supplier for resilience.
Kusumgar already runs the exact coating, lamination and finishing lines these products need.
We win on service, technical capability and flexibility — not on being the cheapest.

product_overview.summary: 600 denier polyester base fabric with polyurethane (PU) coating — the workhorse fabric for tough, water-resistant bags, covers and protective goods.

strengths: Deep coating & lamination capability (the core process for this product)
Aramid / flame-retardant fabric know-how for premium variants
why_kusumgar_wins.positioning: China+1: a reliable, audited non-China source as global buyers de-risk supply.
customer_pain_points: Long lead times from incumbent suppliers
Limited willingness to customise specs / small runs

competitive_positioning.statement: Compete on service and technical capability, not on price.
points: Faster, more responsive communication and sampling than large incumbents
Willingness to customise specifications and run smaller lots
Audited quality (AS9100D / IATF 16949 / ISO 9001) as a trust anchor
India base = tariff / geopolitical diversification for Western buyers

phases.rationale: Closest fit to current lines; fragmented buyers actively seeking a China+1 source.
Larger volumes and longer qualification, but strong margin once specified in.
Highest margin and longest certification — where our AS9100D heritage is a moat.

revenue_scenarios.basis: world HS 5903 annual import value (UN Comtrade)
revenue_scenarios.assumption: Illustrative capture of the real world coated-fabric import market at three share levels. This is a scenario, not a forecast — actual results depend on qualification, capacity and pricing.
